limitations.flight_search: No consumer flight-search endpoint found in current Go Business API 2.0 index. Travel partners API is hotels; Webmaster airline protocol is inbound requests from Yandex to an airline/OTA supplier, not a callable Yandex flight-search API. Private partner availability would require separate provider confirmation, not inferred from Go credentials.
limitations.sandbox: No applicable Business API sandbox documented in reviewed index/quickstart/method pages; Delivery/fleet sandboxes are different APIs.
